messages:
maria: opening a thread for a customer report: intermittent HTML slipping through for JSON mode and it's getting billed.

dan_customer: Hey, we started seeing our client throw parse errors and some unexpected token charges around 03:00 UTC. ~3% failures. Example request id: r_5f8c2a. We use the SDK but can reproduce with curl.

maria: ugh, thanks. Can you paste the minimal curl plus the headers you send and whether you set response_format or rely on Accept negotiation?

dan_customer: minimal repro:
```
curl -i POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2b","input":"status check"}'
```
Response was 200 with content-type text/html and an app error page. Parser choked. We still saw tokens counted in our dashboard.

maria: Not great. Two immediate workarounds you can try: add header `Accept: application/json` OR include "response_format":"json" in the request body. Both force structured mode.

dan_customer: I tried Accept and response_format=json. That fixed the parser error for me locally. But we need the root fix 3 this is production impact.

alex: tagging eng-runtime and eng-billing. @jen can you pull traces for r_5f8c2a and check billing ordering?

jen: grabbed the trace. Gateway returned 200, upstream body was HTML (internal 502 page) but our billing hook runs on gateway 200 before the structured-parser stage. So HTML slips through, parse fails later, but billing already incremented. Log snippet:
```
[2026-04-02T03:12:11Z] req=r_5f8c2a gateway_status=200 upstream_ct=text/html parser_error=InvalidJson start_char='<'
```

jen: repro I ran:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2b","input":"force-html-upstream","response_format":"json"}'
# expect: structured error with non-200 or validated JSON
```

maria: thanks. So two fixes: 1) change billing to be deferred until parse success (short-term change behind flag), 2) make HTML upstream responses map to 502/5xx before gateway returns 200. Also add alerting for upstream content-type mismatches.

alex: created ENG-4017 (runtime: defer billing until parse success) and BILL-1220 (billing: rollback if parse fails). Setting priority P1 for ENG-4017.

maria: dan, we can issue credits for token charges caused by this. @alex will coordinate with finance. Meanwhile please keep using Accept or response_format as a mitigation.

dan_customer: Appreciate it. One more oddity: sometimes only the first chunk is HTML then subsequent stream chunks are JSON. That made our streaming parser break mid-stream.

jen: streaming edge case noted. We'll add a validation that the first byte(s) must match JSON markers when response_format=json; if not, abort streaming and return structured error.

alex: also adding short-term rate-limit bypass to avoid repeated retries causing more charges.

support-bot: reminder created: follow up in 48h. Thread pinned in #support for visibility.

maria: wrapping up: ENG-4017 and BILL-1220 open, mitigation validated by customer, refunds queued. Will post patch ETA once ENG lands the change. Thanks everyone.
